chains.title: RELA binds the alt allele at an unannotated element and may alter FAM110B
chains.element: No annotated cCRE overlaps rs7001688 and the nearest cCRE is 1544 bp away. This shows absence of annotated regulatory annotation, not positive evidence for a functional unannotated RELA-responsive element.
chains.cell_type: Hep 3B2.1-7 is the provided expression context and expresses RELA at 73.44 TPM; this does not establish Hep3B as LDL-relevant or that RELA regulates FAM110B there.

links.claim: QBiC-SELEX group G315 names RELA as an own-model TF and predicts that the alt T allele binds RELA more strongly than ref G (z 33.95, effect 1.34). RELA is chosen over mapped RELB and REL because it has an own model, the strongest positive group score, and expression in Hep3B; this is in vitro binding only, and no ENCODE RELA ChIP-seq peak contains the site, although absence is not conclusive.
The variant has no annotated cCRE overlap and lies 1544 bp from the nearest cCRE, so any RELA effect would require an unannotated element rather than a known regulatory region.

FAM110B is the nearest listed protein-coding gene at 420.6 kb, but distance alone is not target-gene evidence. E06 is only a literature-search hit about pravastatin cardiovascular response, not direct evidence that rs7001688 regulates FAM110B.

Hep 3B2.1-7 is the provided expression context and expresses RELA at 73.44 TPM in the QBiC-SELEX RNA context, but the evidence does not show that Hep3B is the disease-relevant cell type for LDL cholesterol or that RELA regulates FAM110B in Hep3B.

There is no provided genetic or perturbation evidence linking rs7001688 to LDL cholesterol through RELA or FAM110B; GWAS Catalog and Open Targets have no record for the variant, and E06 is only an indirect literature title.

The variant has no annotated cCRE overlap and lies 1544 bp from the nearest cCRE, so an HMGA1 effect would have to act through an unannotated element.

FAM110B is the nearest listed protein-coding gene at 420.6 kb, but distance alone is not target-gene evidence. E06 is only a literature-search hit about pravastatin cardiovascular response, not direct evidence that rs7001688 regulates FAM110B.
Hep 3B2.1-7 expresses HMGA1 at high levels in the QBiC-SELEX RNA context, but the evidence does not show that Hep3B is disease-relevant for LDL cholesterol or that HMGA1 regulates FAM110B there.

There is no provided genetic or perturbation evidence linking rs7001688 to LDL cholesterol through HMGA1 or FAM110B; GWAS Catalog and Open Targets have no record for the variant, and E06 is only an indirect literature title.
